name: 路易·德布罗意
bio_short: 法国物理学家，1929年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。他在1924年提出了革命性的“物质波”假说（`de_broglie_matter_waves_1924`），预言了电子等实物粒子也具有波动性，从而建立了波粒二象性的统一理论。
bio_short_en: A French physicist and 1929 Nobel laureate. He proposed the revolutionary 'matter wave' hypothesis in 1924 (`de_broglie_matter_waves_1924`), predicting that matter particles like electrons also exhibit wave-like properties, establishing the theory of wave-particle duality.
